details.name: Improvement: root-cause share
details.message: Fixing causes: 61% of the 348 cards finished this week fixed a cause or added a system, the rest fixed one more case of a repeat problem (last week 60%). 41 problems keep coming back; 41 have a card to fix the cause. 2 fixes claimed to stop a repeat, and it came back anyway. An independent check of 8 fixes from this week, reading only the code, found 8 of 8 fixed the cause.

details.name: Improvement: done claims that held
details.message: Done claims that held: 93% (730 of 784) over 30 days, 87% (249 of 287) over 7 days; 11 more could not be checked on the recheck machine. On the first independent check: 89% (701 of 789).
